name: Interpreter
overview: The role of the interpreter in Scripture is to bridge understanding between divine revelation and human comprehension, as seen in Joseph's God-given ability to explain dreams (Genesis 40:8; 41:16) and his use of an interpreter to communicate with others (Genesis 42:23). Interpreters also serve to clarify God's law to His people, enabling them to grasp its meaning (Nehemiah 8:8), and act as mediators who reveal God's righteousness to mankind (Job 33:23). This ministry of interpretation extends to both the understanding of languages and the discernment of spiritual truths within congregations and Christian churches.
